items.mainDefect: In Google updateEvent, the fallback searches for the destination whose externalId equals a falsy externalCalendarId, so it never matches and the update is sent with an undefined calendarId.

secondary.defect: Google deleteEvent has the same dead fallback, so it falls back to the "primary" calendar, gets a 404 that is silently ignored, and leaves an orphaned event on the destination calendar.

items.mainDefect: Google createEvent picks the calendar only by matching credentialId, so destinations with a null credentialId never match and the event is created on "primary" instead of the selected destination calendar.

secondary.defect: EventManager's no-credentialId else-branch calls createEvent without passing externalId, so the booking reference is saved with an undefined externalCalendarId.

items.mainDefect: Google createEvent picks the calendar only by matching credentialId, so destinations with a null credentialId are silently created on "primary" instead of the configured externalId.

secondary.defect: EventManager's no-credentialId branch never passes destination.externalId to CalendarManager.createEvent, so the stored booking reference has no externalCalendarId.

items.mainDefect: Google createEvent puts events on the credential's primary calendar instead of the configured destination when the destination has no credentialId.

secondary.defect: The no-credentialId path stores externalCalendarId as undefined in the booking reference, which feeds the broken update/delete fallback.

items.mainDefect: EventManager createAllCalendarEvents' no-credentialId else-branch calls createEvent without externalId, so the booking reference is saved with a null externalCalendarId.

secondary.defect: Google createEvent selects the calendar only by credentialId match, so a destination with no credentialId is created on "primary" instead of the selected destination.externalId.

items.mainDefect: Google updateEvent's fallback find-by-externalId only runs when externalCalendarId is falsy, so it never matches and the update is called with calendarId undefined.

secondary.defect: Google deleteEvent has the same dead fallback, so calendarId is always undefined in that case.

items.mainDefect: Google updateEvent's fallback compares destination externalIds against a falsy externalCalendarId, so selectedCalendar is undefined and the Google update fails.

secondary.defect: Google deleteEvent contains the same self-nullifying fallback expression, so cancellations reached from handleCancelBooking fail too.
